description: Bitbucket Pipelines workflow engineering: bitbucket-pipelines.yml, custom deployment steps, branch permissions, pull request merge checks, service containers, and secure repository variables.
instructionsMarkdown:
# Bitbucket Pipelines CI/CD Workflow Engineering

Implement deterministic, secure continuous delivery workflows using Bitbucket Pipelines.

## Key Principles & Invariants
- Secure all secrets, API keys, and deployment credentials as Secured Variables in Bitbucket repository settings.
- Enforce pull request merge checks: all pipelines must pass and approvals must be logged before merging.
- Spin up ephemeral database and cache service containers for hermetic integration test suites.
- Use step-level deployment environments to track deployment state across environments.
